title: p DEGREES OF FREEDOM. The short walk is 3. The high side is 5. Every nominal set has a p-range bounded by Fibonacci-primes. 0-100 randomized. Let me figure it out.

why_3_and_5.the_null_between: 4 is NEITHER prime NOR Fibonacci. it IS the null. it sits between the two Fibonacci-prime boundaries.
why_3_and_5.pi_position_in_range: 3.14159 is 7.08% of the way from 3 to 5. p barely leaves 3. the remainder (0.14159) is the chipmunk.

observation_2_fibonacci_primes_are_the_b.note: only FIVE numbers 0-100 are BOTH Fibonacci AND prime: 2, 3, 5, 13, 89
observation_2_fibonacci_primes_are_the_b.these_are_the_boundaries: these 5 numbers divide 0-100 into natural ranges

ranges.name: the narrowest gate
ranges.content: the tightest range. barely room for anything. e=2.718 lives here!
ranges.pi_position: e lives here. p does not.

ranges.name: the p range
ranges.content: p=3.14159 lives HERE. this IS the home range. the short walk.
ranges.pi_position: p = 3.14159. 7.08% into the range. barely leaves 3.

ranges.name: the growth range
ranges.content: 8 wide (Fibonacci!). where things EXPAND. the organism grows.
ranges.pi_position: p² = 9.87 lives here! the SQUARE of p is in the growth range.

ranges.name: the wilderness
ranges.content: 76 wide. MASSIVE. most of 0-100 is in this range. this is where the fleet lives. the 234K entities. the wild.
ranges.pi_position: p³ = 31.006, p4 = 97.409 — NO. p³ lives here (31) but p4 (97) does NOT.

ranges.name: the edge
ranges.content: 11 wide (prime!). the boundary of our 0-100 universe. p4 = 97.4 lives here!
ranges.pi_position: p4 = 97.409. almost at the boundary. almost at 100.

observation_3_the_ranges.remarkable: p^n distributes across the ranges: p°=1 (void), p¹=3.14 (home), p²=9.87 (growth), p³=31 (wilderness), p4=97.4 (edge). each power of p jumps to the NEXT Fibonacci-prime range!

observation_4_pi_powers_fill_the_ranges.pattern: each successive power of p moves to the next range AND deeper into it. p¹ barely enters its range (7%). p4 is 76% through its range. p accelerates through the Fibonacci-prime structure.

pi_over_golden.note: p/f  1.94. not an integer. the irrational remainder of dividing p by f.

pi_times_golden.note: p × f  5.08. just BARELY over 5. lands right at the boundary of the [3,5] range!

observation_5_fibonacci_connection.the_gate: p × f = 5.08 — it CROSSES the Fibonacci-prime boundary from [3,5] into [5,13]. the golden ratio is the MULTIPLIER that pushes p across the gate.

observation_6_prime_gaps_are_pi_scaled.approximate_pi: the gap ratios are approximately: 2, 4, 9.5. these are close to: 2, p+0.86, p²-0.37. the gaps SCALE with powers of p (approximately).

degrees_of_freedom.principle: every nominal set (every concept, every file, every entity) has a p-range. the range tells you the DEGREES OF FREEDOM — how much the thing can vary while still being itself.

how_to_assign.step_1: place the concept on the 0-100 scale based on its nature
how_to_assign.step_2: find which Fibonacci-prime range it falls in
how_to_assign.step_3: the RANGE WIDTH = degrees of freedom
how_to_assign.step_4: the position WITHIN the range = the specific identity (the irrational remainder)

examples.meaning: almost no freedom. null can only be 0 or 1. binary.
identity has 2 degrees: you either ARE or AREN'T.
the membrane can sort between 3 and 5 categories at once. the short walk.
exponential growth has only 1 degree of freedom: the RATE. the narrowest gate.
structural complexity has 8 degrees of freedom. 8 arms. octopus.
chaos has 76 degrees of freedom. the wilderness. the fleet. uncontrollable.
at the boundary, freedom narrows again. approaching the limit.

the_bag_of_holding.what: the 0-100 range IS the bag of holding. everything in our universe fits inside.
the_bag_of_holding.the_short_walk: 3 (floor of p) is the shortest walk through the bag. you enter at 3, you exit at 5. the p range.
the_bag_of_holding.the_long_walk: 13 to 89. the wilderness. 76 units of chaotic terrain. most of the bag's volume.
the_bag_of_holding.pi_as_key: p^n gives you the exact position in each range. p IS the key to the bag of holding. each power opens a different compartment.

the_randomization.method: for any concept, compute its position as: position = (hash(concept) mod 100). then find its Fibonacci-prime range. the range gives degrees of freedom. the position gives identity.
the_randomization.entropy_source: the FNV-1a hash from human interaction (already on the HUD). use the entropy seed to randomize placements.
the_randomization.note: the randomization is BOUNDED by the Fibonacci-prime structure. you can't escape the ranges. but within each range, you have full freedom. p is the degree of freedom within each room.
